lesson.title: Listen: B1 · Tell the story clearly: before, during and after
lesson.subtitle: B1 · Listening · 4 min

steps.fr: Quand j'ai ouvert le courriel, l'organisatrice avait déjà déplacé l'atelier. Il pleuvait fort, alors j'ai pris le métro vers la nouvelle salle.
steps.question: What had happened before the speaker opened the email?
options: The metro had stopped for the day
The speaker had taught the workshop
steps.explain: The organizer had already moved the workshop.

steps.fr: J'attendais devant la salle quand le gardien m'a expliqué que le groupe était parti. Il avait affiché un avis près de l'entrée, mais je ne l'avais pas remarqué.
steps.question: Why did the speaker not know the group had left?
options: The entrance was closed the previous day
They had not noticed the posted notice
steps.explain: The speaker says they had not noticed the notice.
